g.title: Sheet.12
g.desc: Sleep Mode: Inputs: INH_N=0 Gate Drivers – passive OFF (Gxx-S...
g.text: Sleep Mode: Inputs: INH_N=0 Gate Drivers – passive OFF (Gxx-Sxx passive Clamping, Gxx-GND passive discharge enabled) ERR_N = “high” due to external pull-up resistor and not driven actively “low”

g.title: Sheet.22
g.desc: Set HBx_EN = 0 Gxx-GND passive discharge enabled
g.text: Set HBx_EN = 0 Gxx-GND passive discharge enabled

g.text: Disable CP, CSA and VREF LDO

g.title: Sheet.34
g.desc: 1) Power-up mode with SPI communication released by TLE9186 i...
g.text: 1) Power-up mode with SPI communication released by TLE9186 in case valid SDI SPI command has been received 2) Normal operation mode can be entered with Charge pumps and half bridges disabled (CP_EN = 0, HBx_EN = 0) 3) In normal-operation mode it is recommended to check ERR_N pin voltage level is driven “high” by external pull-up resistor RERR_PU 4) During tcore_up ERR_N pin will be set to „Low“
